entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Root cause: `_multiply_seq_by_int` in `astroid/protocols.py` only guarded against a huge multiplier (`value > 1e8`), but not against a huge *product* of element count and multiplier, so `[[]] * 825 * 16547118` attempted to build a list of ~1.4e10 elements and raised `MemoryError` (and negative huge multipliers raised uncaught `OverflowError`). Fix: compute the filtered elements first, then return an empty list when `value <= 0` or the source list is empty (matching Python semantics), return `[Uninferable]` when `len(filtered_elts) * value > 1e8`, and only otherwise perform the multiplication. Verified with the repro, the overflowing/negative/zero multiplier edge cases, and the existing protocol/inference/node test suites all pass.
